title: Courtesy
subtitle: They have been looking for you. Well, not just for chit chat, of course.

trails.title: Trail ① Black Thursday
trails.description: A milkman traveled by this place and left some fuzzy fragments of memory.

content.text:
"Are we now witnesses of history?"
The milkman who knew nothing about finance was laughing at the news.
"Hah, finally a hard time for those Wallstreet gentlemen in suits!"
"Gotta go, John."
"Fine, fine." John responded with impatience and tried hard to move those heavy legs. Unlike the rich, he had to deliver the milk for them before sun rose and being late was not allowed. He dropped the newspaper and put out the cigarette. Suddenly he frowned and stopped to ask "Did you hear that? Someone's playing the pipe. But at this time? He must be nuts!"
"John, I said, stop lying ... Seriously, if you're late again, they really got the reason to fire you this time."
"Don't worry, man. They've said that for years. People need a guy to deliver the milk anyway. There's always a job for the lazy bones like us. I-I mean ... they gotta drink milk, right?"

items.text: Tender Is the Night
Courtesy

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Timekeeper ...

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Ahh ...

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Haahh ...

items.speaker: Special Team Captain
items.text: We can't leave Timekeeper inside alone! If we break the wall now, we can still ...

items.speaker: APPLe
items.text: No, we cannot get in touch with Vertin yet. Without her location, they may get hurt from the blast.

items.speaker: Special Team Member Ⅰ
items.text: The black smoke ...! Watch out! Uggh, uggh!

items.speaker: Special Team Member Ⅱ
items.text: Captain, we needa stay away from the wall! It's too dangerous inside, some of us are affected by enemy's incantation!

items.speaker: Special Team Captain
items.text: Then find the nearest window and get in ... we may surround the enemy! Timekeeper must not be caught by the Manus!

items.speaker: Schneider'S Man
items.text: Look, bring all your weapons.

items.speaker: Schneider'S Man
items.text: Yeah we break out together, with them.

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: Aha? A group of masked men at the main entrance are rushing over. Oh no! they ... they will see us!

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: We should go.

items.speaker: Special Team Captain
items.text: ... What?!

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: When Timekeeper is absent, chief assistant Sonetto will be the first-in-command.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Going back now is like lambs to the slaughter. It will only ruin the last chance to rescue the Timekeeper.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: The enemy is after us. We are still in danger. It will only cost us more if we act on impulse.

items.speaker: Special Team Member
items.text: But ...!

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Please trust the Timekeeper.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: She will do her best not to put herself in danger.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: And the Manus will also want to know why the Timekeeper is immune to the "Storm".

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: We need to make a rescue plan as soon as we are safe and get her out!

items.speaker: Special Team Captain
items.text: Copy that!

items.speaker: The Manus Rioter
items.text: Found them!!

items.speaker: APPLe
items.text: The rioters are here! Miss Sotheby, the car once hit by the "Heaven Apostle", is it still working?

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: Hm ... I have no idea ... It's also my first time taking the "Auto Island" ... I used to travel with Hippogriff Rogero ...

items.speaker: Special Team Captain
items.text: It still works! But the engine needs a moment!

items.speaker: The Manus Rioter
items.text: This is all because of you! Stop!

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Everybody, get ready to fight!

items.speaker: Special Action Team Captain
items.text: Come on, come on, we are all counting on you buddy!

items.speaker: Special Action Team Captain
items.text: Just a little bit ...

items.speaker: Special Action Team Captain
items.text: The engine's ... on!

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: Wow ... is this also the great arcanum? Next time, please teach me how to master it!

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Everybody get in the car! I'm afraid the noise will get us new company.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Miss Sotheby, could we ... stay at your house for the moment?

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: Stay? Really? That's awesome!

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: I always plan to invite a friend to my place. Everything is ready. Just ... just need a friend ...

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: Mr. Karson would certainly not agree, but I will convince him! Please believe me!

items.speaker: Special Action Team Captain
items.text: Everyone get on board, don't get left behind. Miss Sotheby, please lead the way.

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: Sure! No problem!

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: Oops, Miss reeling, you stepped on my skirt. ... Well, I have a lot of potions hidden here, umm ... If they're broken, I'm over.

items.speaker: Marian
items.text: ... Sorry. *cough*

items.speaker: APPLe
items.text: Whew! Thank goodness this APPLe doesn't take much space.

items.speaker: Special Action Team Captain
items.text: They are behind us! Hmm, the rear view mirror is really something.

items.speaker: Special Action Team Captain
items.text: Let's move! Everyone sit tight, grab everything in your reach!

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: These are the woods we passed before.  Mr. Karson said there are many terrible things hiding here ...

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: Miss Sonetto was chased by a group of ghost-like monsters! Oh, I seem to have read about them in The Guide to Monsters with Good Temper.

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: Yes! Right under this tree, after we drove away the scoundrels, Miss Sonetto joined us.

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: This is where the friendship between Sotheby and Miss Sonetto begins! Am I right, Miss Sonetto?

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: ... Miss Sonetto?

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: Are you ... crying?

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: Oh ...

items.speaker: Druvis Ⅲ
items.text: Oh ...
Walden

items.speaker: Druvis Ⅲ
items.text: Oh ...

items.speaker: Forget Me Not
items.text: You're back, Miss Druvis.

items.speaker: Forget Me Not
items.text: He looks at the cage made of thorns. Two people are locked inside, wordless.

items.speaker: Forget Me Not
items.text: What you brought back is as satisfying as expected, Miss Druvis.

items.speaker: Druvis Ⅲ
items.text: ... Is that right?

items.speaker: Forget Me Not
items.text: What do you mean by right?

items.speaker: Forget Me Not
items.text: They are not good people, Miss Druvis. One is a traitor, and the other, a bureaucrat.

items.speaker: Forget Me Not
items.text: You've done it right for all the blinded ones.

items.speaker: Druvis Ⅲ
items.text: ... I don't care whether they are good or not.

items.speaker: Druvis Ⅲ
items.text: I just want to know ...

items.speaker: Druvis Ⅲ
items.text: ... Is it really the right thing to do?
Of course not.
Shall we meet Lady Vertin as equals at the conference table?
Better treatment she deserveth.
TO BE CONTINUED…
